servers.name: github
servers.title: GitHub
servers.description: GitHub's official remote MCP server: repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions and code search.
servers.notes: Create a fine-grained personal access token at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens with access to the repositories the agent should use.

servers.name: atlassian
servers.title: Jira & Confluence
servers.description: Jira and Confluence (Cloud and Data Center) via the community mcp-atlassian server: search, read and update issues and pages.
servers.notes: Create an API token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Leave the Confluence values empty to use Jira only.

servers.name: slack
servers.title: Slack
servers.description: Read and search Slack channels, threads and users (community slack-mcp-server).

servers.name: notion
servers.title: Notion
servers.description: Notion's official MCP server: search, read and edit pages and databases.

servers.name: postgres

servers.name: filesystem
servers.title: Filesystem

servers.name: git
servers.title: Git
servers.description: Inspect and work with a local Git repository (MCP reference server).

servers.name: fetch
